description_en: Modifies the status of an AppKey
kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-app-key-state --lang example-string --app-key-id example-string --state example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAppKeyState

parameters.help_en: Specifies the language for requests and responses. Valid values: zh for Chinese, en for English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；默认为 zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the public DNS AppKey to query or operate
parameters.help_zh: 要查询或操作的公共 DNS AppKey 标识
parameters.name: app_key_id

parameters.help_en: The target status of the AppKey. Valid values: OPENED indicates that the AppKey is enabled, and CLOSED indicates that the AppKey is disabled
parameters.help_zh: AppKey 目标状态：OPENED 表示开启，CLOSED 表示关闭
parameters.name: state
